name: Network Segmentation Assessment
description: Ability to assess the design and effectiveness of network segmentation controls. Covers VLAN segmentation verification, firewall zone analysis, micro-segmentation review, trust boundary identification, and practical testing of segmentation effectiveness through controlled pivot attempts.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to network segmentation assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands network segmentation principles and their role in defense-in-depth
evidence: Can explain VLANs, firewall zones, DMZs, and trust boundaries
Understands why segmentation is critical for limiting breach impact
Knows common segmentation architectures (flat, tiered, micro-segmented)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic segmentation verification under supervision
evidence: Tests inter-VLAN connectivity to verify segmentation controls under guidance
Reviews firewall rules governing zone-to-zone traffic
Identifies obvious segmentation gaps (open management ports, flat subnets)

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses network segmentation and identifies bypass opportunities
evidence: Maps all network segments and trust boundaries in the target environment
Tests segmentation effectiveness through practical connectivity and pivot testing
Identifies segmentation weaknesses that allow lateral movement between zones
Produces segmentation assessment reports with risk-rated findings

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses complex segmentation architectures; designs segmentation tests; mentors others
evidence: Designs comprehensive segmentation testing plans for large environments
Identifies non-obvious trust path violations through protocol and service analysis
Mentors junior staff on segmentation assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines segmentation assessment methodology; advises on architecture; trains teams
evidence: Authored the lab's network segmentation assessment methodology
Advises clients on segmentation architecture design and improvement
Published research on segmentation bypass techniques or assessment methods
Trains teams on segmentation assessment strategy and architecture analysis

assessment_methods.description: Assess segmentation in a multi-zone lab environment and identify all inter-zone access paths not sanctioned by the security policy
Review segmentation assessment reports from recent engagements for completeness and accuracy of trust boundary analysis
